targets.text: SPFx Developer • Power Apps Developer • SharePoint Administrator
Microsoft 365 Developer and SharePoint Administrator with 3.7 years of experience in SharePoint Online, SharePoint Server 2016, SPFx,
Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Nintex, Nintex Automation Cloud, ShareGate, PnP PowerShell, and REST API integrations.
Experienced in SPO tenant administration, governance reporting for 20,000+ SharePoint Online sites, SP2016 production support, and
SharePoint customization using SPFx web parts. Worked on SPFx solutions by developing modern client-side web parts, integrating
SharePoint lists and libraries, consuming REST API data, customizing UI components, and supporting deployment activities in SharePoint
Online. Also experienced in Canvas App development, approval workflow automation, Power BI dashboards, migration validation, and
legacy Nintex workflow modernization to NAC. Skilled in role-based access control, site permissions, form validation, UAT coordination,
production troubleshooting, and delivering secure Microsoft 365 business solutions.
SPFx and Development: SPFx Web Parts, Extensions, React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, REST APIs, PNP JS, JSON Formatting,
Power Platform: Power Apps Canvas Apps, Power Fx, Patch, Collections, Variables, Forms, Galleries, Delegation, Validations, Power
Reporting and Migration: Power BI, Excel Reports, ShareGate Desktop, PNP PowerShell, SQL Server, Dataverse, ServiceNow, UAT, SIT,
Nintex and NAC: Nintex Forms, Nintex Workflows, Nintex Automation Cloud, Dynamic Rules, Conditional Logic, Email Notifications,
SharePoint Administration: SharePoint Online, SharePoint Server 2016, Site Collections, Lists, Libraries, Content Types, Metadata,
Automate Cloud Flows, Approval Flows, Scheduled Flows
